text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty triggered for auth-service (token-verifier). Alarm: auth.verify.failure.rate > 5% over 1m. Incident INC-9932. Paging oncall @alice. Details: https://pagerduty/INC-9932

alice: I'm seeing a big uptick in `verify_token` failures. Logs show repeated `failed to fetch jwks` and 5xx from okta EU introspect endpoints. Digging in now.

ben: egress traces confirm spikes of 502 from `okta.eu/api/v1/introspect` plus intermittent 429s. Auth verify failure rate at ~0.063.

carla: customer impact: console login broken for several EU tenants, API clients getting 401s. Escalating to Support channels.

dave: mitigation plan draft: 1) enable JWKS cached fallback; 2) increase jwks_cache_ttl to 10m; 3) add client-side retry/backoff with jitter; 4) short-term bypass for console sessions.

oncall-sre: Applying config change to token-verifier:
```
kubectl set env deploy/token-verifier JWKS_CACHE_TTL=600
kubectl rollout restart deploy/token-verifier
```
ETA ~2m.

ben: starting canary (10% traffic) with new cache TTL, monitoring auth.verify.failure.rate and 5xx counts.

alice: handoff note — I'm primary until 15:30 UTC, @ben secondary. Vendor contact initiated.

okta-support-bot: Okta support ticket 987654 created. Okta acknowledges a regional edge degradation in EU and is investigating.

carla: impact tally (live): 8 org tenants with console issues, ~42 API clients seeing token verify 401s. Notified top-affected customer via support DM.

ben: canary looks good — failures down from 6.3% -> 0.9% in 3m. Rolling to 50% now.

oncall-sre: Temporary flag added to authz-proxy to allow cached session tokens to bypass live introspect for 30m (auto-revert):
```
curl -X POST https://internal-config/flags -d '{"flag":"bypass_okta_introspect","value":"true","duration_s":1800}'
```
(reverts automatically after 30m).

alice: status update for page: mitigation in progress, vendor engaged, customer impact trending down. Monitoring closely. :thumbsup:

ben: I also saw bursts of 429 on introspect earlier — looks like rate-limit cascade on Okta edge. Added jitter/backoff and client circuit-breaker config to reduce fanout.

carla: created incident channel #incident-auth-okta-2771234567 and drafted customer comms: "We are experiencing third-party auth provider degradation causing intermittent login failures. Mitigation in progress; next update in 30m." Sending now.

incident-bot: Incident INC-9932 state updated -> partial mitigation. Postmortem owner assigned: alice. Follow-up due in 48h. :calendar:

alice: Action items: 1) postmortem w/ timeline + vendor logs; 2) add circuit breaker and better jitter to introspect client; 3) increase jwks cache and add synthetic monitor for JWKS endpoint. Owners: @alice, @ben, @carla.

dave: keep monitoring for 1h. If error rate <0.5% and stable for 30m we plan to declare incident resolved.
